SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, y.Consumption
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212' AND c.Segment = 'LAM'

FROM yearmonth
JOIN customers ON yearmonth.CustomerID = customers.CustomerID
WHERE customers.Segment = 'SME' AND yearmonth.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'CZK' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN c.Currency = 'EUR' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS ConsumptionDifference
FROM 
    yearmonth y
JOIN 
    customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    y.Date BETWEEN '201201' AND '201212'

SELECT 
    yearmonth.`Date` AS Year,
    SUM(yearmonth.`Consumption`) AS TotalConsumption
FROM 
    yearmonth
JOIN 
    customers ON yearmonth.`CustomerID` = customers.`CustomerID`
WHERE 
    customers.`Currency` = 'CZK'
GROUP BY 
    yearmonth.`Date`
ORDER BY 
    TotalConsumption DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    ym.Date AS Month,
    ym.Consumption
FROM 
    yearmonth ym
JOIN 
    customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE 
    c.Segment = 'SME' 
    AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
ORDER BY 
    ym.Consumption DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH low_consumption AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        AVG(y.Consumption) AS avg_consumption
    FROM 
        yearmonth y
    JOIN 
        customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'CZK' 
        AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment
),
sme_avg AS (
    SELECT avg_consumption FROM low_consumption WHERE Segment = 'SME'
),
lam_avg AS (
    SELECT avg_consumption FROM low_consumption WHERE Segment = 'LAM'
),
kam_avg AS (
    SELECT avg_consumption FROM low_consumption WHERE Segment = 'KAM'
)
SELECT 
    (sme_avg.avg_consumption - lam_avg.avg_consumption) AS diff_sme_lam,
    (lam_avg.avg_consumption - kam_avg.avg_consumption) AS diff_lam_kam,
    (kam_avg.avg_consumption - sme_avg.avg_consumption) AS diff_kam_sme
FROM 
    sme_avg, lam_avg, kam_avg

WITH ConsumptionData AS (
    SELECT 
        c.Segment,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2012%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2012,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ym.Date LIKE '2013%' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Consumption2013
    FROM 
        yearmonth ym
    JOIN 
        customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE 
        c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY 
        c.Segment
)
SELECT 
    Segment,
    (Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) AS IncreaseOrDecrease,
    ((Consumption2013 - Consumption2012) / Consumption2013) * 100 AS PercentageOfIncrease
FROM 
    ConsumptionData
ORDER BY 
    PercentageOfIncrease DESC, PercentageOfIncrease ASC
LIMIT 1, 1

LIMIT 1

    END AS Gender_Deviation,
    ABS(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
        (SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) + SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END))

FROM

    SEX = 'M'

FROM Examination

FROM 
    Examination AS T1

    Patient AS T2 ON T1.`ID` = T2.`ID`
JOIN 
    Laboratory AS T3 ON T2.`ID` = T3.`ID`
ORDER BY 
    T3.`HGB` DESC
LIMIT 1

JOIN 
    Patient ON Examination.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE 
    Patient.Description = '1994-02-19' 
    AND Examination.`Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'

     SUM(CASE WHEN T2.Birthday = '1959-02-18' AND T1.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN T1.`T-CHO` ELSE 0 END)) /

    Laboratory AS T1
JOIN 
    Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

    T2.Birthday = '1959-02-18'

FROM Patient P

WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1980' AND E.Diagnosis = 'RA'

SELECT 
    d.A2 AS district_name,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM 
    trans t
JOIN 
    account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN 
    disp disp ON a.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON disp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE 
    t.type = 'VYDAJ' 
    AND t.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY 
    d.A2
ORDER BY 
    total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE dis.A8 = 1 AND l.status = 'C'

SELECT COUNT(client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'M'
AND district.A15 = (
    SELECT MAX(A15)
    FROM district
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
)
AND district.A15 = (
    SELECT MAX(A15)
    FROM district
    WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '1995'
    ORDER BY A15 DESC
    LIMIT 1, 1
)

SELECT DISTINCT t1.account_id
FROM trans t1
JOIN disp d ON t1.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE t1.type = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
  AND t1.amount < (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM trans WHERE type = 'VYBER KARTOU' AND date LIKE '1998%')
  AND t1.date LIKE '1998%'

SELECT 
    dis.A11 AS average_salary,
    d.type AS account_type
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN 
    district dis ON a.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE 
    d.type != 'OWNER'
    AND dis.A11 BETWEEN 8000 AND 9000

SELECT AVG(district.A15) AS avg_crimes
FROM district
JOIN account ON district.district_id = account.district_id
WHERE district.A15 > 4000
AND account.date >= '1997-01-01'

SELECT t.trans_id, t.date, t.amount, t.k_symbol
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3356 AND t.operation = 'VYBER'

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN client.gender = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(client.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM 
    client
JOIN 
    disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN 
    account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN 
    district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE 
    district.A11 > 10000

SELECT 
    ((SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1997' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END) - 
      SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)) / 
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', loan.date) = '1996' THEN loan.amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM 
    loan
JOIN 
    disp ON loan.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN 
    client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE 
    client.gender = 'M'

SELECT 
    t1.frequency, 
    t2.k_symbol, 
    SUM(t2.amount) AS total_amount
FROM 
    account AS t1
JOIN 
    trans AS t2 ON t1.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE 
    t1.account_id = 3 AND t2.amount = 3539
GROUP BY 
    t1.frequency, 
    t2.k_symbol

SELECT 
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_male_clients
FROM 
    client AS T1
JOIN 
    disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id
JOIN 
    account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id
WHERE 
    T3.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dis ON c.district_id = dis.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, dis.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(loan.amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status = 'D' AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT 
    c.client_id, 
    julianday('now') - julianday(c.birth_date) / 365.25 AS age
FROM 
    client c
JOIN 
    disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN 
    card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
JOIN 
    account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE 
    ca.type = 'gold' 
    AND d.type = 'OWNER'
